hooks.command: sh -c 'PROJECT=$(pwd | xargs basename); curl -s -H "Title: ntfy send [cc:$PROJECT]" -H "Priority: default" -H "Tags: white_check_mark" -H "Click: android-app://com.termux" -d "Task completed in $PROJECT" ntfy.sh/$NTFY_TOPIC > /dev/null'

sh -c 'PROJECT=$(pwd | xargs basename); curl -s -H "Title: ntfy send [cc:$PROJECT]" -H "Priority: high" -H "Tags: warning" -H "Click: android-app://com.termux" -d "Permission required in $PROJECT" ntfy.sh/$NTFY_TOPIC > /dev/null'
